Boostech Bloemfontein · Knowledge from the Boostech network

A failed AdBlue or SCR system can derate a truck, trigger a no-start countdown and create repeated repair costs. Boostech Bloemfontein assists fleet operators with diagnostics-led AdBlue fault assessment, supported software solutions and professional AdBlue removal for suitable trucks.

Three Scania G410 trucks, repeated pump failures

A recent Boostech fleet case involved three Scania G410 trucks with failed AdBlue pumps. Two replacements had already cost a combined N$90,000, while the third failure represented another potential N$45,000 repair. The operator also reported spending approximately N$35,000 per month on AdBlue across the three trucks.

AdBlue repair or removal?

The correct starting point is a diagnostic scan. Pump, wiring, dosing, crystallisation and NOx-sensor faults can produce similar warnings. Where the SCR system must remain operational, repair may be appropriate. Where removal is lawful and suitable for the truck's use, vehicle-specific software can eliminate recurring AdBlue dependence and associated derating faults.

Truck AdBlue specialists in Bloemfontein

Boostech Bloemfontein supports compatible commercial vehicles in Bloemfontein and across the Free State by arrangement. Send the truck make, model, year, engine, fault codes, location and number of vehicles so the exact ECU and software support can be confirmed.
